name: Penalty Transaction Record 2
definition: Specifies further details of the transaction for which the penalties apply.

SettlementTransactionOrCorporateActionEv.name: Settlement Transaction Or Corporate Action Event Type
SettlementTransactionOrCorporateActionEv.definition: Choice of type for the transaction reported.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

CorporateActionRelatedDate.name: Corporate Action Related Date
CorporateActionRelatedDate.definition: Date related to a corporate action event.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

CashAccountOwner.name: Cash Account Owner
CashAccountOwner.definition: Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

PostingAmount.name: Posting Amount
PostingAmount.definition: Amount of money that is to be/was posted to the account.

AcknowledgedStatusTimeStamp.name: Acknowledged Status Time Stamp
AcknowledgedStatusTimeStamp.definition: Time stamp on when the transaction is acknowledged.

MatchedStatusTimeStamp.name: Matched Status Time Stamp
MatchedStatusTimeStamp.definition: Time stamp on when the transaction is matched.

SettlementStatusFailing.name: Settlement Status Failing
SettlementStatusFailing.definition: Instruction is failing. Settlement at the instructed settlement date is no longer possible.

BusinessDayEvent.name: Business Day Event
BusinessDayEvent.definition: System event relevant to the computation of the penalty.
